nodes.description: Amount of asset locked into the current short option position; added to balances in totalBalance and used in withdraw math.
Otoken address the vault is currently shorting; read in sellOptions and currentOptionExpiry.
Otoken address queued by the manager for the next roll; cleared in rollToNextOption.
Timestamp gate computed from block.timestamp + delay before a roll is permitted.
Deposit cap enforced in _deposit, settable by manager via setCap.
Withdrawal fee denominator applied in withdrawAmountWithShares via wmul.
Recipient of the instant withdrawal fee transferred in _withdraw.
Privileged role compared against msg.sender in the onlyManager modifier.
Immutable collateral asset address used for deposits, withdrawals and swaps.
Immutable AirSwap ISwap contract address invoked in sellOptions and used as approve target.
Immutable IProtocolAdapter whose code is delegatecalled for createShort/closeShort.
Immutable minimum share/asset supply guard used in deposit and withdraw math.
Constant 0.9e18 ratio of balance locked into short positions.
Immutable WETH address used for ETH deposit/withdraw wrapping.
Constructor wiring immutable asset, factory, adapter, WETH, USDC, swap contract and decimals.
Initializer guarded by the initializer modifier; sets owner, cap, fee recipient and withdrawal fee.
Owner-only setter that changes the privileged manager address.
Owner-only setter for the withdrawal fee recipient.
Manager-only setter for the instant withdrawal fee, capped below 1 ether.
Payable nonReentrant deposit of ETH which is wrapped into WETH then deposited.
NonReentrant ERC20 deposit pulling asset from msg.sender via safeTransferFrom.
Private share accounting routine that mints vault shares after cap and minimum supply checks.
NonReentrant withdrawal that burns shares and forwards native ETH to msg.sender via low-level call.
NonReentrant withdrawal that burns shares and safeTransfers asset to msg.sender.
Private routine computing withdraw amount with fees, burning shares and paying the fee recipient.
Manager-only function storing the next option and a timestamp-based ready-at gate.
Manager-only roll that closes the expired short, delegatecalls createShort and approves the swap contract.
Manager-only emergency close of the current short via adapter delegatecall.
Manager-only function that submits a signed AirSwap order to the external swap contract.
Manager-only setter for the deposit cap.
View returning the expiry timestamp of the currently shorted option.
Public view computing withdrawable amount and fee from a share amount with supply guards.
Private view performing the pro-rata share math over lockedAmount plus free balance.
View returning the maximum shares withdrawable across the vault.
View returning the maximum asset amount withdrawable for an account.
View converting an asset amount into shares.
View returning an account's vault balance in asset terms.
View returning lockedAmount plus the vault's free asset balance.
View returning the vault's free asset balance.
View returning the immutable token decimals.
Access control modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the manager state variable.
Caller-supplied address used for access checks, mint/burn targets and ETH transfer recipients.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for the option ready-at delay and roll timing.
Low-level call forwarding ETH to msg.sender after share burn, external control transfer point.
Delegatecall into the adapter executing createShort with vault storage context.
Delegatecall into the adapter executing closeShort, returning withdrawn assets.
External call to the AirSwap settlement contract executing a user supplied order.
External WETH deposit/withdraw calls mediating native ETH conversion.
Fixed point wmul and SafeMath mul/div/add/sub arithmetic in share and fee computations.
Token transfer/approve operations executed against arbitrary ERC20 asset and otoken addresses.
Share supply mutation in _deposit and _withdraw affecting totalSupply-based pricing.
Calldata option terms used to derive the otoken address and validate underlying/strike.
Caller supplied number of vault shares to burn.
Caller supplied asset amount to deposit.
Caller supplied AirSwap order struct passed to the swap contract.
New manager address supplied by the owner.
New withdrawal fee value supplied by the manager.
New deposit cap supplied by the manager.
Account whose vault share balance is queried.
Local amount of asset released by _withdraw and forwarded to the caller.
Local amount derived as wmul(currentBalance, lockedRatio) and stored as lockedAmount.
Local sum of lockedAmount and free asset balance used as the share denominator.
Local totalSupply snapshot used in pro-rata share math.
Local fee amount routed to the fee recipient on withdrawal.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against manager inside the onlyManager modifier.
manager state variable is the privileged address read by onlyManager.
onlyManager gates setManager execution.
onlyManager gates setWithdrawalFee execution.
onlyManager gates setNextOption execution.
onlyManager gates rollToNextOption execution.
onlyManager gates emergencyWithdrawFromShort execution.
onlyManager gates sellOptions execution.
onlyManager gates setCap execution.
msg.sender is the depositor credited with shares in depositETH.

msg.sender is the mint recipient inside _deposit.
msg.sender is the burn account inside _withdraw.
msg.sender is the arbitrary recipient of the low-level ETH value call.
The external value call allows the recipient to reenter withdrawETH before completion.
A malicious recipient can reenter the sibling withdraw entrypoint during the ETH transfer.
Reentrant withdrawal path reads and pricing depends on lockedAmount state.
The external swap call can call back into vault functions before state settles.

rollToNextOption delegatecalls adapter createShort passing vault storage.

deposit credits the deposit through _deposit.

newManager parameter applied by setManager.

assetAmountToShares performs mul and div on asset amount and supply.

account parameter selects the balance queried in accountVaultBalance.
totalBalance adds lockedAmount to the free asset balance.

option terms are reconstructed and passed to the delegatecall createShort.
share parameter is the burn amount supplied to _withdraw.
share parameter selects the withdraw amount in withdrawETH.
share parameter selects the withdraw amount in withdraw.
share parameter is priced by withdrawAmountWithShares.
amount parameter is the asset amount pulled in deposit.
amount parameter is used to price minted shares in _deposit.
withdrawAmount local carries the payout in withdrawETH.
withdrawAmount local carries the payout in withdraw.

feeAmount local is returned by withdrawAmountWithShares.

emergencyWithdrawFromShort clears nextOption.

normalization_plan.reason: The calldata option terms parameter only flows into the option address resolution and short creation driven by setNextOption.
The share parameter is the caller supplied burn amount consumed by the withdrawal routines.
The amount parameter is the caller supplied asset quantity credited by the deposit routines.
The order parameter is the caller supplied AirSwap payload forwarded to the swap contract.
The newManager parameter is only used to update the manager state variable.
The newWithdrawalFee parameter is only used to update instantWithdrawalFee.
The newCap parameter is only used to update the cap state variable.
The account parameter simply selects the share balance queried for a withdraw quote.
The local withdraw amount is produced by _withdraw and consumed by the withdrawETH payout.
The shortAmount local is computed and stored as lockedAmount inside the roll routine.
The total local is an intermediate pool size used only in the share pricing math.
The shareSupply local is a transient totalSupply snapshot used only in the share pricing math.
The feeAmount local is produced by the share math and paid out inside the withdrawal routine.
